name: The Moss-twined Heart
label: Quest

clips.title: The story
paras: Near Lake Al'Ameth, Denalan studies a strange heart taken from Blackmoss the Fetid. Dark, oily moss covers the core, yet it keeps beating after being cut from the timberling.

Blackmoss the Fetid's heart still pulses after being cut from the timberling. Dark, oily moss hides nearly all of the timberling's core, but a slow rhythm continues within it. That pulse points to a corruption reaching beyond ordinary rot in Teldrassil's wild plants.

Denalan, a researcher of local flora near Lake Al'Ameth, takes a keen interest in the heart and recognizes its troubling corruption. Timberlings should be gentle beings tied to the boughs of the World Tree, yet this core bears a virulent blight. Troubled by what he sees and eager to understand it, Denalan plans to plant and study the organ, hoping to learn how foul moss takes root in the island's soil.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.
Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! You have something for me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!
Thank you for bringing this to me, friend. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
